name: Say 'over time' after a verb of change (change, diminish, worse)
description: Completes the phrase "over time" after any verb or phrase of change ("the market value of equity can change over", "saving money over time", "organisms have changed over", "lose their pressure over", worse, diminish). Ablated, the model prefers "based", "in", "and" (p ≈ 0.78), "the" (p ≈ 0.85 after "money over"), "quickly" or a period.
